rev.t: Recently visited 1947 Restaurant and it was a fantastic experience. The atmosphere was comfortable and pleasant. The food quality and presentation were impressive, and the service was quick and courteous. The staff ensured everything was smooth and enjoyable. Highly satisfied and recommended!
Food is very tasty and staff service is also supportive.

Good restaurant with good ambience. Veg food was very tasty. Cost is a bit pricier. But as a whole the way experience was good.
Go on a weekend afternoon. Nights are busy on saturdays and sundays.
